trial_title: Ultrasound Assisted Puncture of AV Fistulas in Chronic Hemodialysis Patients
brief_summary:
The puncture of the vascular access in hemodialysis patients remains challenging even in the hands of experienced dialysis nurses. Unsuccessful punctures are associated with resource wastage, traumatism of the AV shunts, shortening of the effective dialysis time and poor patient satisfaction.

eligibility_table.justification: The patient has an arteriovenous malformation (AVM), but there is no specific information about the presence of an AV-shunt.

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients with recognized difficult vascular access at any time (potentially each patient)
